metadata.description: Open-source AI agent skills and plugins by Lionel Sim (The AI Capitol).

plugins.description: Tailor a resume to a specific job opening: ATS keyword scoring, an honest three-bucket gap analysis, and a polished rewrite that never fabricates experience or metrics. v2.0.0 adds a callable MCP server + REST API (score_resume, extract_keywords, gap_analysis, check_format).
plugins.name: resume-optimizer

plugins.description: Human-approved outbound GTM pipeline: learn an offer, score leads against an ICP, draft personal emails for approval, triage replies, and learn which segments to scale or pause. Python CLI with an actions manifest; no MCP server - see PLUGIN.md in the folder.
plugins.name: auto-gtm-agent

plugins.description: 120 GTM and community management plugins: scoring, triage, checklists, audits, drafts and reports - deterministic, guardrailed, drafts only, no auto-send. Includes its own MCP server and REST API.
plugins.name: gtm-community-plugins
